subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Utilizar software, inclusive programas de edição de texto, para editar e publicar os textos produzidos, explorando os recursos multissemióticos disponíveis.

components.description_en: Use word processing or publishing tools to produce clearly formatted writing
components.cc_component_description: Use word processing or publishing tools to produce clearly formatted writing

cc_matches.description: Use technology, including the Internet, to produce and publish writing and present the relationships between information and ideas clearly and efficiently.
With guidance and support from adults, explore a variety of digital tools to produce and publish writing, including in collaboration with peers.
